title: Native-JSON (new events schema) test matrix is opt-in via test-new-events-schema label
answers: Why didn't the native-JSON tests run on my PR?
How do I run the new events schema backend tests in CI?
When to add the test-new-events-schema label
body:
Backend CI doubles its Django/product test matrices (schema_modes [false, true]) only when RUN_NEW_EVENTS_SCHEMA is 'true'.
- Enforced in `.github/workflows/ci-backend.yml` on both matrix builders: `contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'test-new-events-schema') || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'`.
- Merge queue and scheduled master runs are legacy-schema only (no label, not dispatch), so a PR touching event-schema behavior without the label is never tested against native JSON before merge.
- Label PRs that change event ingestion/cleaning, event or property reads, generated SQL over events, or schema-specific snapshots (see AGENTS.md CI section and `.github/pull_request_template.md`).
- Leave unrelated PRs unlabeled; the label doubles the matrix.
applies: Backend CI workflows and any PR touching events-table code or snapshots
